name: Hostile Takeover
description: Declare a right to occupy a dwelling. Mundane security ignores the changeling, doors open, and animal or hobgoblin sentries stand aside. Extend the effect to up to Presence companions kept in sight. Supernatural dwellings prompt a Clash of Wills, and the Contract cannot overcome a resident who also knows it.
loophole: Carry an object belonging to the owner or main resident.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Animal sentries actively serve the Beast.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: Gain +2 on the Clash of Wills against a supernatural dwelling's owner.

h-seemings.Darkling: Gain +3 to Stealth and Larceny inside the dwelling.
h-seemings.Elemental: Once before expiry, enter one aperture and leave through another within the dwelling.
h-seemings.Ogre: May affect dwellings controlled by characters who know this Contract, provoking a Clash of Wills.
h-seemings.Wizened: Complex household appliances serve within their normal physical capabilities.

name: Mask of Superiority
description: Walk into a location as though entitled to belong to one organization represented there.
success: Observers believe the changeling has Status in the chosen organization equal to Presence. Acting out of character may require Presence + Subterfuge contested by Wits + Empathy to preserve the deception.
exceptionalSuccess: Observers instead believe he is a trusted Ally rated at Presence and excuse most gaps in institutional knowledge.
dramaticFailure: Members immediately recognize the lie and become hostile.
loophole: Dress loosely according to the organization's dress code.

seemingBenefits.Fairest: Reduce starting Doors by one in Social maneuvering against affected characters.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Add invocation successes, maximum +5, to Intimidation against anyone who believes the ruse.

h-seemings.Beast: May use the effect on animals.
h-seemings.Darkling: At scene end, people who interacted with the Darkling cannot recall her appearance in detail unless she was exposed as an outsider.
h-seemings.Elemental: Gain 8-again on Presence + Subterfuge when acting out of character.
h-seemings.Wizened: Appear as custodial staff; rolls to notice the Wizened in forbidden areas suffer half the invocation successes, rounded up.

name: Paralyzing Presence
description: Overwhelm a target whose attention the changeling has captured with a magnificent and terrible presence.
dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Wyrd vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: The target suffers Insensate.
exceptionalSuccess: The target also gains Cowed.
dramaticFailure: The unimpressed target inflicts Shaken on the changeling.
loophole: Touch the target while they are otherwise alone.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Use Manipulation instead of Presence.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: Gain +3 dice to invoke the Contract.

h-seemings.Beast: Spend 1 Willpower to apply the exceptional-success effect without rolling one.
h-seemings.Elemental: Apply the benefit to another character in the victim's line of sight.
h-seemings.Ogre: Spend 1 additional Glamour to deal 1 lethal damage without ending Insensate.
h-seemings.Wizened: Gain +2 on called shots against the Insensate victim.

name: Summon the Loyal Servant
description: Animate a drop of blood and nearby ephemeral or discarded matter into a simple loyal servant with Power 1, Finesse 3, Resistance 2, iron as its only frailty, and Size 1–7. It has appropriate natural advantages, obeys simple commands, and watches for threats.
loophole: Perform a significant favor for the chosen element or material during the scene.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: For +●○, merge with it, substitute its Attributes where desired, become immune to its material or element, and add +1L to weapon modifiers.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: For +○, bind one servant to a Hollow indefinitely while it remains there.

h-seemings.Beast: The servant gains +1 Resistance.
h-seemings.Darkling: The servant cannot be bound or grappled.
h-seemings.Ogre: The servant gains +1 Power.
h-seemings.Wizened: The servant understands complex commands and has a young child's intelligence.

name: Tumult
description: Write a visible target's true name on a leaf and fold it into an origami bird to read and manipulate shards of dreams and nightmares.
success: Learn whether the target has Disoriented, Guilty, Lost, Paranoid, Obsession, Spooked, Stoic, or Withdrawn. Per success, inflict one listed temporary Condition or define one trigger that delays the Contract.
exceptionalSuccess: Apply one additional effect.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains one listed Condition of the player's choice.
loophole: Plant an origami bird on the target during the scene.

seemingBenefits.Fairest: Also read and inflict Inspired, Swooned, and Wanton.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Also read and inflict Bestial, Cowed, and Frightened.

h-seemings.Beast: Also read or inflict Berserk, Reckless, and Shaken.
h-seemings.Darkling: Also read or inflict Informed, Leveraged, and Notoriety.
h-seemings.Elemental: Also read or inflict Competitive, Confused, and Distracted.
h-seemings.Wizened: Also read or inflict Fatigued, Lethargic, or Volatile; Volatile affects one held item.

name: Discreet Summons
description: Reach blindly into a small container to summon an object, or open a door and invite a Wyrd 3 or lower hobgoblin to perform one task.
dicePool: Manipulation + Persuasion + Wyrd vs. Composure + Tolerance
action: Instant for an object; Contested for a hobgoblin
duration: One scene or until released or ignored
success: Produce a functional Size 1, Availability 3 or lower object previously seen or handled, or summon a normal hobgoblin to perform one task. A sufficiently enticed hobgoblin comes willingly and makes the roll uncontested.
exceptionalSuccess: The object may be Size 5 and Availability 5; a hobgoblin enthusiastically serves the assignment's spirit and performs useful follow-up tasks.
dramaticFailure: Retrieve an item with Volatile, or summon a secretly hostile hobgoblin.
loophole: Draw the object from an enemy's holdings, or promise and deliver something practically or morally difficult for the hobgoblin.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Draw the object or hobgoblin from a sufficiently large shadow.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: The hobgoblin serves until the next sunrise or sunset even when ignored.

h-seemings.Beast: Summon a mundane animal as though it were a hobgoblin.
h-seemings.Elemental: Change the produced object into another after concealing it from view for one turn.
h-seemings.Ogre: Conjure an object up to Size 3 normally or Size 6 exceptionally.
h-seemings.Wizened: Spend 1 Willpower to apply the exceptional-success effect without rolling one.

name: Mastermind's Gambit
description: Spend at least five minutes monologuing a concrete goal into a parchment plan or repository granting +5 equipment. It lasts until chapter's end or definitively succeeds or fails.
action: Instant; takes at least five minutes
duration: One chapter or until the plan succeeds or fails
loophole: Draw the plan, hierarchy, or repository index on paper at least 50 years old.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: For +○, a repository lasts one story and expands to a Mental Specialty the Elemental possesses.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: Create an organization suited to counter an enemy's influence instead of a plan.

h-seemings.Beast: Gain Steadfast on an exceptional use of the repository, in addition to any other Condition.
h-seemings.Darkling: Investigation using repository information exceptionally succeeds on three successes.
h-seemings.Ogre: Gain +2 weapon damage when the plan involves violence.
h-seemings.Wizened: The repository also grants 8-again.

name: Pipes of the Beastcaller
description: Play a silver flute to call all animals of one named species within Animal Ken miles and give them understandable verbal commands.
dicePool: Manipulation + Animal Ken + Wyrd vs. Resolve + Composure
action: Instant for willing animals; Contested for hostile animals
duration: Until the task is completed or becomes impossible
success: The animals gather, obey simple commands to the best of their ability, and return to report completion or an insurmountable obstacle.
exceptionalSuccess: Control them for a day and night and issue new commands whenever speaking with them; mistreatment or impossible demands allow a new contest.
dramaticFailure: A large hostile animal or swarm arrives and attacks the changeling.
loophole: Dance while playing the flute, mimicking the desired species.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Maintain an empathic link, awareness of condition and relative location, and give new orders remotely.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: For +●, summon and command a second species.

h-seemings.Darkling: Animal minions impose -5 on attempts to notice them while stealthy.
h-seemings.Elemental: Grant the animals immunity to harm from one chosen element.
h-seemings.Ogre: The animals are immune to fear, including supernatural fear.
h-seemings.Wizened: The minions gain +2 to Intelligence and Wits actions.

name: The Royal Court
description: Assume leadership of a meeting and prevent anyone present from inflicting bodily harm. Supernatural compulsions toward violence prompt a Clash of Wills. The Contract cannot stop violence already underway.
loophole: Stand and deliver a speech lasting at least five minutes.

seemingBenefits.Fairest: Also prohibit Social intimidation and threats while allowing goodwill.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Also prohibit mental harm, including Clarity attacks but not breaking points.

h-seemings.Beast: May end violence already underway, affecting at most Wyrd + 1 mortals.
h-seemings.Darkling: Choose one character who is exempt.
h-seemings.Elemental: For one scene after expiry, affected characters suffer -2 to violence.
h-seemings.Ogre: Gain +3 to related Clashes of Wills.

name: Spinning Wheel
description: Name one reasonably probable, not overly specific experience for the target within the next lunar month. The changeling may maintain up to Wyrd pending destinies.
action: Extended; each roll takes 10 minutes; target is the higher of Wyrd or Resolve
duration: Until the lunar month ends or the event occurs
success: Apply invocation successes, maximum ±5, as bonuses to rolls leading toward the event and penalties to rolls obstructing it. The Contract creates the event, not its outcome.
exceptionalSuccess: Specify an action the target can take to prevent the experience and end the Contract.
dramaticFailure: The changeling suffers a dramatic failure on a crucial roll chosen by the Storyteller during the next chapter.
loophole: Prick the target with a needle or pin and draw blood; doing this to a willing target inflicts 1 lethal damage.

seemingBenefits.Fairest: Gain +3 to invoke a positive destiny and Inspired for actions supporting it.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Gain +3 to invoke a negative destiny and Steadfast for actions supporting it.

h-seemings.Beast: Gain +3 to invoke destinies involving animals or nature and Steadfast for supporting actions.
h-seemings.Darkling: Gain +3 to invoke a strange destiny and Inspired for supporting actions.
h-seemings.Elemental: Gain +3 to invoke a destiny involving yourself and Inspired for supporting actions.
h-seemings.Wizened: Gain +3 to invoke a destiny involving objects or machines and Steadfast for supporting actions.

name: Blessing of Perfection
description: Bless an object to replace its equipment bonus with Wyrd for one action, or encourage another person's Crafts, Medicine, or Computer action to replace that Skill with Wyrd.
loophole: Accept payment for the Contract, then bury the coins or traded object.

seemingBenefits.Fairest: Also replace another person's Expression, Persuasion, or Socialize with Wyrd.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: A blessed object retains its bonus for all uses during the scene.

h-seemings.Beast: Also apply the Contract to another character's Athletics, Brawl, or Survival.
h-seemings.Darkling: Also apply it to another character's Larceny, Stealth, or Subterfuge.
h-seemings.Elemental: A blessed Skill retains the bonus for every roll in the scene.
h-seemings.Ogre: Double Wyrd, maximum +5, when blessing a weapon.

name: Changing Fortunes
description: Manipulate the target's next roll, affecting a given target only once per chapter.
success: Per success, add or subtract two dice from the next roll or shift its exceptional-success threshold by one, in any combination. The threshold cannot fall below one and a chance die cannot exceptionally succeed.
exceptionalSuccess: Instead specify a trigger for the effect; it expires unused at scene's end.
dramaticFailure: Apply the rolled effects against the changeling, chosen by the Storyteller.
loophole: Dramatically fail one of the changeling's own actions this scene; alternatively, dramatically failing later in the scene refunds the Glamour.

seemingBenefits.Ogre: The target gains Shaken whenever using the cursed pool until the sun next crosses the horizon.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: After the affected roll, force one reroll; the second result stands.

h-seemings.Beast: Once per scene, the victim suffers half Wyrd bashing when using the cursed pool until the next horizon crossing.
h-seemings.Darkling: Regain 1 Willpower if the subject dramatically fails because of the Contract in your presence.
h-seemings.Elemental: Spend 1 additional Glamour to grant 9-again or remove 10-again from the action.
h-seemings.Fairest: Regain 1 Willpower if the subject exceptionally succeeds because of the Contract in your presence.

name: Light-Shy
description: Become invisible to the Mask and all senses, though recording technology still detects the changeling. Aggressive action, harm, or any supernatural effect on another ends the Contract.
loophole: Stand motionless in darkness or deep shadow for one minute.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Recording technology also fails to detect the Darkling.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Target an object instead; witnesses rationalize its absence, but accidental contact ends the effect.

h-seemings.Beast: Grant the effect to an animal by touch.
h-seemings.Elemental: Use one supernatural effect on someone despite this Contract, once per chapter.
h-seemings.Fairest: Appear as a different known person in audio or visual recordings.
h-seemings.Ogre: Take one aggressive action against someone else without ending the effect, once per chapter.

name: Murkblur
description: Overwhelm the target's senses with impossible Arcadian beauty.
dicePool: Manipulation + Subterfuge + Wyrd vs. Wits + Tolerance
success: Inflict Blinded in both eyes.
exceptionalSuccess: Also inflict Deafened in both ears.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains Disoriented.
loophole: Eat a creature's eye while invoking the Contract.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: Instead make the target believe an element engulfs them, imposing suitable Tilts chosen by the Storyteller.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Also inflict Disoriented.

h-seemings.Beast: Also inflict Arm Wrack or Leg Wrack.
h-seemings.Darkling: Spend 1 additional Glamour to make the victim lose the next action.
h-seemings.Fairest: Insert idealized visions of yourself, imposing -3 on the victim's next attack against you.
h-seemings.Ogre: Also inflict Beaten Down on a successful invocation.

name: Trivial Reworking
description: Place a mundane Size 3 or smaller object under the Mask and alter its visual aspects while preserving its basic shape. The illusion affects all mundane senses but not physical tests or beings who see through the Mask.
loophole: Touch another object similar to the desired illusion during the same scene.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Subtract Manipulation from attempts to detect the forgery.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Affect an object of any Size.

h-seemings.Beast: Use the Contract on an animal without compelling behavior outside its nature.
h-seemings.Elemental: Gain +3 on Social actions supported by an item made to appear natural rather than manufactured.
h-seemings.Fairest: The altered object withstands sophisticated inspection.
h-seemings.Ogre: Beings normally immune to the Mask must win a Clash of Wills to see through the effect.

name: Changeling Hours
description: Manipulate an object's time: repair 1 Structure per turn up to Crafts; inflict 1 Durability-ignoring damage per turn up to Crafts; or freeze it immovably and make it immune to damage or change.
loophole: Name a former, but not current, owner of the object.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: Also affect instances of the Elemental's associated element.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: For +○, make the freezing effect permanent; attempts to override it prompt a Clash of Wills.

h-seemings.Beast: The freezing effect heals one bashing per turn, up to Survival; it becomes permanent if the duration covers natural healing time.
h-seemings.Darkling: Speed and rewind without visibly changing the object.
h-seemings.Fairest: Spend 1 Willpower to make rewind permanent, subject to Clash of Wills against overriding magic.
h-seemings.Ogre: Spend 1 Willpower to make speeding permanent, subject to Clash of Wills against overriding magic.

name: Dance of the Toys
description: Awaken a visible mechanical device within 10 × Wyrd yards or meters and give it one simple command. It cannot exceed its normal movement; damaging actions use invocation successes as their attack pool. Changing its behavior requires Strength + Resolve exceeding the invocation successes.
success: The device animates and follows the single command.
exceptionalSuccess: Purchase it as a permanent one-dot Retainer; otherwise it remains animated for one chapter.
dramaticFailure: The device animates and actively turns against the changeling.
loophole: Inscribe a unique name on the object and call it to life by that name.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Grant animal-like intelligence and multiple or complex commands.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Permit movement beyond normal operation at Speed equal to Wyrd, ending if it leaves range.

h-seemings.Darkling: Make the device invisible until it interacts, subject to Clash of Wills against illusion sight.
h-seemings.Elemental: Once per scene, the device reflexively produces enough favored element to fill one square meter.
h-seemings.Fairest: A normal success permits purchase as a Retainer of at least two dots.
h-seemings.Ogre: Apply Strength as a penalty to attempts to alter the device's course.

name: Hidden Reality
description: Create a minor feature on an existing lifeless object of any Size, provided it could always have existed and nobody saw that it was absent this scene. It vanishes at scene's end or when unattended.
loophole: Spend one minute theatrically searching for the feature and express surprise upon finding it.

seemingBenefits.Fairest: Instead change one nearby person's Virtue or Vice with Manipulation + Subterfuge + Wyrd contested by Resolve + Wyrd.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: For +●, create an entirely new object reasonably found in the area.

h-seemings.Beast: Apply the Contract to simple life such as plants and insects.
h-seemings.Darkling: The change is disturbing and inflicts Shaken on those who encounter it.
h-seemings.Elemental: Make Wyrd + 1 additional changes to the area.
h-seemings.Ogre: Once per chapter, spend 1 additional Glamour to last until next sunrise.

name: Stealing the Solid Reflection
description: Pull a mundane, mirrored copy of an object through a reflective surface large enough to pass it. Neither original nor duplicate has a reflection while the Contract lasts.
success: The reflected object becomes solid for the scene but has no supernatural properties.
exceptionalSuccess: The reflection remains solid until the sun next crosses the horizon.
dramaticFailure: The surface shatters and the original takes Wyrd damage ignoring Durability.
loophole: Coax the original's owner into expressing a debt to the changeling during the scene.

seemingBenefits.Fairest: Steal a living reflection with mundane traits capped by Wyrd and no supernatural traits; it is friendly and deferential. On dramatic failure, a mirror person instead seeks revenge.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: For +●, preserve supernatural properties of the copied object.

h-seemings.Beast: The copy gains half Stamina, rounded up, as Durability.
h-seemings.Darkling: Copy objects with even a faint reflection.
h-seemings.Elemental: Copy insubstantial or fluid things such as water or fire.
h-seemings.Ogre: Damage the copy to inflict the same damage on the original.

name: Tatterdemalion's Workshop
description: Take a jury-rigging Build Equipment action in one turn to create any mundane Size 5 or smaller object from improvised materials without proper tools. Reduce penalties for bonuses or benefits by half Wyrd, rounded up.
loophole: Wear large old glasses and use archaic tools.

seemingBenefits.Ogre: Materials need not plausibly fit the resulting object.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Jury-rig a complex object of any Size.

h-seemings.Beast: Gain +3 to Build Equipment when using only natural materials.
h-seemings.Darkling: Choose for the object to grant no equipment bonus or not function for others.
h-seemings.Elemental: Spend 1 Glamour to store the object impossibly in any Size 1+ container until used or sunrise.
h-seemings.Fairest: Create an ideal example, including brand, granting 9-again to all uses.

name: Glimpse of a Distant Mirror
description: Turn a reflective surface into a visual window through another surface that previously reflected the changeling's face. Anyone may view through it, limited by the surfaces' clarity; afterward, the changeling sees disturbing hints of mirror people for the scene.
loophole: Use a mirror belonging to a sworn enemy without claiming ownership of it.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Also view through a surface reflecting someone bound by a promise or pledge to the Beast, or invoking his name.
seemingBenefits.Darkling: Transmit sound and optionally allow those on the far side to see and hear the Darkling.

h-seemings.Grimm: Also see through a reflection showing someone easily fooled or manipulated.
h-seemings.Elemental: See perfectly through an opaque reflective surface.
h-seemings.Fairest: Spend 1 Willpower to use a Common Contract on someone seen through the mirror.
h-seemings.Ogre: Break the far reflective surface, dealing Wyrd dice of bashing to anyone directly before it.
h-seemings.Wizened: Also see through a surface reflecting someone who cheated you or owes you a favor.

name: Know the Competition
description: Challenge an opponent to a game lasting at least ten minutes and study how she thinks and uses resources.
dicePool: Manipulation + Socialize + Wyrd vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Win and learn the target's Virtue, Vice or equivalent anchors, and one Aspiration.
exceptionalSuccess: Also learn a second Aspiration.
dramaticFailure: Lose, and the opponent learns the changeling's Needle, Thread, and one Aspiration.
loophole: Goad the target into challenging the changeling to the game.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Once before dawn, think of the target to know her exact location, present activity, and current plans to leave.
seemingBenefits.Darkling: Observe up to Wyrd opponents at once in a multiplayer game.

h-seemings.Grimm: Learn two Aspirations and which one the subject is closest to fulfilling.
h-seemings.Elemental: Choose to lose the game to gain +2 on Social actions with the opponent for the chapter.
h-seemings.Fairest: Also learn the highest Social Skill and associated Specialties.
h-seemings.Ogre: Gain 8-again on Intimidation against the subject for the scene.
h-seemings.Wizened: Also learn the highest Mental Skill and associated Specialties.

name: Portents and Visions
description: Recite an accelerating stream of events, names, objects, and places for at least one minute while seeing the target, or a mirror when targeting oneself, and choose to reveal the past or near future.
dicePool: Manipulation + Occult + Wyrd vs. Composure + Tolerance
action: Contested; takes at least one minute
success: Past: See the most important event relevant to current interests that befell the target, even if forgotten, or the target's latest promise or deal. Future: See the most important event, promise, or deal likely within the next few days; the changeling, and an informed target, gain Informed.
exceptionalSuccess: Evoke the event's associated emotions in the target and inflict an appropriate Condition.
dramaticFailure: See a false event and signs of the Gentry's approach, gaining Paranoid.
loophole: Tear up a picture of the target.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Instead see a past crime or transgression and inflict Guilty regarding it.
seemingBenefits.Elemental: Instead see the next violent event and grant the target Giant for one scene if it occurs.

h-seemings.Grimm: See the last piece of media that most profoundly affected the subject.
h-seemings.Beast: Gain +3 to invoke if the subject can see you.
h-seemings.Fairest: Instead see a past romantic encounter and give the subject Inspired regarding it; cannot target yourself.
h-seemings.Ogre: Instead see a past frightening encounter and give the subject Spooked regarding it.
h-seemings.Wizened: Use the Contract on inanimate objects.

name: Read Lucidity
description: Read another person's mental stability at a glance.
dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Wyrd vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Learn the target's maximum and current Clarity in relative terms and all Clarity Conditions.
exceptionalSuccess: Also learn the circumstances of the target's most recent Clarity damage.
dramaticFailure: Receive incorrect Clarity values without realizing it.
loophole: Touch the target skin-to-skin.

seemingBenefits.Beast: On exceptional success, roll invocation successes as a psychic Clarity attack.
seemingBenefits.Darkling: On exceptional success, grant the target Defense equal to Wits against the next Clarity attack this session.

h-seemings.Grimm: On exceptional success, learn one Touchstone's identity and may nullify it for the subject's next breaking point.
h-seemings.Elemental: On exceptional success, the Elemental's next breaking point this chapter suffers -1 die.
h-seemings.Fairest: On exceptional success, heal 1 mild Clarity damage from the subject.
h-seemings.Ogre: On exceptional success, gain +3 to the next Contract used on the subject.
h-seemings.Wizened: On exceptional success, automatically open one Door in the next Social maneuver with the subject.

name: Walls Have Ears
description: Tell an object an Arcadian secret and purchase one or more revelations about it.
options: Learn construction and weak points: halve Durability against the changeling and add Intelligence to repair or modify it.
Learn perfect use: gain 9-again when wielding or using it.
See the last person who handled it and everyone within three meters at that time.
loophole: Speak the secret aloud in public among mortals who can hear it.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Gain Informed about the current owner, or a described previous owner if the Darkling owns it.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Spend +● per additional point in its history viewed.

h-seemings.Grimm: Spend 1 Glamour to learn the name of the person with the strongest emotional connection to the object.
h-seemings.Beast: Exceptionally succeed with three successes when ambushing the last person who touched it.
h-seemings.Elemental: Gain 8-again instead of 9-again when wielding the item.
h-seemings.Fairest: Gain two effects for the first Glamour spent.
h-seemings.Ogre: Reduce the object's Durability by three quarters, rounded down.

name: Props and Scenery
description: Transform into an inanimate object with its standard traits and Size up to the changeling's own.
options: +1 Durability, repeatable.
Limited mobility appropriate to the form.
Increase or decrease Size by 1, repeatable.
Other Storyteller-approved benefits.
success: Assume the form and purchase one listed benefit per success.
exceptionalSuccess: For 3 Experiences, permanently learn the form and assume it reflexively for ● with no roll, one-success benefits, or Loophole; normal invocation remains possible.
dramaticFailure: Become briefly misshapen and suffer a Clarity attack with half Wyrd dice, rounded up.
loophole: Invoke in plain sight of several people while nobody is looking directly at the changeling.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Duration lasts until the sun next crosses the horizon.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Assume objects up to twice normal Size by default.

h-seemings.Grimm: A permanent form may be assumed as though three successes were rolled whenever it fits the current role or disguise.
h-seemings.Beast: The form is mobile and moves at half normal Speed.
h-seemings.Elemental: Shift the form unseen without changing purchased traits; permanent acquisition still requires exceptional success.
h-seemings.Fairest: Become an ideal version that observers choose first among similar objects.
h-seemings.Wizened: A functional form grants its wielder +2 equipment in addition to its normal bonus.

name: Reflections of the Past
description: Rewind a reflective surface to show up to one scene from a specified past time or known event, visible to all viewers from the surface's original angle.
success: View up to a week, month, season, year, or decade back for one through five Glamour respectively.
exceptionalSuccess: Peer around the reflection's edges to see details outside its original angle.
dramaticFailure: See a false event and signs of the Gentry's approach, gaining Paranoid.
loophole: After taking at least 1 lethal damage this scene, let blood fall onto the surface.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Use kenning to detect supernatural phenomena in the reflected event.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: Inflict Leveraged on one character seen in the vision.

h-seemings.Grimm: Automatically identify anyone in the scene acting out of character or under coercion.
h-seemings.Beast: See through the eyes of animals reflected in the vision.
h-seemings.Elemental: See reflected characters' auras and emotional states.
h-seemings.Ogre: Exceptionally succeed on three when the event involves violence or fear.
h-seemings.Wizened: Perceive Health, Durability, and relevant Tilts of people and equipment in the scene.

name: Riddle-Kith
description: Sculpt a changeling's mien to resemble another kith's trappings without copying its blessing or changing apparent seeming. It cannot copy a specific individual's mien; forcing the change is a three-die breaking point.
dicePool: Manipulation + Larceny + Wyrd vs. Composure + Tolerance
action: Instant for willing targets; Contested for unwilling targets
success: The target outwardly resembles the chosen kith.
exceptionalSuccess: When self-targeting, spend ○ to make the appearance indefinite.
dramaticFailure: The target loses all kith benefits for the scene without assuming another mien.
loophole: Give something without recompense beyond gratitude to a changeling of the desired kith during the scene.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: The target loses their own kith benefit and gains the imitated kith's benefit.
seemingBenefits.Elemental: Also make the target appear to belong to another seeming.

h-seemings.Grimm: Spend 1 Willpower to apply the exceptional-success effect without rolling one.
h-seemings.Beast: Give the subject +1 lethal damage with unarmed attacks.
h-seemings.Fairest: Give the subject +2 Socialize with characters who perceive the enhanced beauty.
h-seemings.Ogre: Give the subject +2 Intimidation with characters who perceive the enhanced mien.
h-seemings.Wizened: On exceptional success, indefinitely alter another willing subject; each character may receive this only once.

name: Skinmask
description: Recite three known facts about a mortal or Masked target previously met and copy their outward appearance; for a changeling, copy Mask and mien. Social rolls remain necessary to imitate behavior. Copying someone resembling the changeling's untaken human future restores 1 Willpower.
loophole: Hold an object belonging to the person being copied.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: After copying one identity three times, buy it as Alternate Identity at any rating and assume it reflexively for ●.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: Gain +3 to imitate the copied target's behavior.

h-seemings.Grimm: Regain 2 Willpower when assuming the appearance you would have had without abduction.
h-seemings.Beast: Also regain 1 Willpower for assuming a personality significantly unlike your own.
h-seemings.Elemental: Also regain 1 Willpower for assuming a form significantly unlike your own.
h-seemings.Ogre: The next breaking point in the form suffers -2, once per day before the horizon changes.
h-seemings.Wizened: Use one copied Mental Skill when it exceeds your own rating.

name: Unravel the Tapestry
description: Rewind the last ten seconds, or one complete Initiative turn, and choose different actions while everyone without similar temporal power repeats their original actions. It triggers automatically once per story if the changeling dies and can pay; surviving grants Spooked.
success: Replay the interval and alter the changeling's actions.
exceptionalSuccess: Gain 8-again on rolls made during replayed time.
dramaticFailure: Gain Insensate and, if acting again this scene in initiative, automatically take the lowest Initiative.
loophole: Incur an unpaid debt during the scene.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Before time restarts, reflexively move up to Stealth yards or meters.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Gain one surprise attack against a viable target during the replay.

h-seemings.Grimm: After a failed Subterfuge action, gain 8-again to retry even without exceptional invocation.
h-seemings.Beast: May revive more than once if costs are paid; later revivals inflict three mild Clarity damage.
h-seemings.Elemental: Exceptionally succeed on three successes.
h-seemings.Fairest: Spend 1 additional Glamour to apply the effect to another and remain aware of resulting changes.
h-seemings.Ogre: If revived, gain +5 weapon modifier on the next successful attack against your killer.

name: Cloak of Night
description: In dim or dark conditions, cloak up to Dexterity willing companions. One Stealth roll, with +half Wyrd rounded up, hides the group until someone attracts attention; each member may take one Stealth-based reflexive action per turn.
duration: One scene or until attention is attracted
loophole: Everyone dons clothing associated with sneaks or rogues, such as masks or cloaks.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: The group retains the benefits even after attracting attention.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Use Stamina instead of Dexterity to determine protected companions.

h-seemings.Beast: Exude a territorial aura that causes uncovered characters to avoid your position subconsciously.
h-seemings.Elemental: Create a plausible static darkness patch of up to Wyrd meters around you.
h-seemings.Fairest: Invoke with Presence instead of Dexterity.
h-seemings.Wizened: Gain 8-again on Stealth.

name: Fae Cunning
description: Apply Defense against Firearms and retain Defense while surprised or distracted; supernatural denial prompts a Clash of Wills. A successful Dodge may redirect the attack to another valid target, automatically hitting with successes equal to Presence.
loophole: Challenge an opponent to an immediate duel.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: Add Resolve to Initiative and Speed.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Mundane weapons striking the Ogre take Stamina damage, subject to Durability.

h-seemings.Beast: Add half Athletics, rounded up, to damage inflicted by Dodging.
h-seemings.Darkling: Become invisible for one full turn after an exceptional Dodge.
h-seemings.Fairest: Also inflict Swooned on the attacker.
h-seemings.Wizened: Gain +2 Defense against Firearms.

name: Shared Burden
description: Let blood flow onto a target and inflict lethal damage on the changeling; each point heals 2 damage, bashing before lethal, but never aggravated. Damage self-inflicted this way cannot be magically healed.
loophole: Hold a strip of skin at least three inches long from the creature that inflicted the injuries.

seemingBenefits.Ogre: Heal 3 damage per lethal damage inflicted.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Heal lethal damage before bashing.

h-seemings.Beast: The first Wyrd damage levels suffered are bashing.
h-seemings.Darkling: Roll Wyrd; every two successes negate one damage from the Contract.
h-seemings.Elemental: Take 1 aggravated damage to heal all of the subject's bashing and lethal wounds.
h-seemings.Fairest: Heal aggravated damage by spending 1 Willpower per aggravated wound.

name: Thorns and Brambles
description: Create a mobile Wyrd-yard or meter radius of brambles and choose one manifestation. In the Hedge they remain stationary and threaten the changeling too.
options: Leechweed: characters moving faster than Speed 2 lose 1 Glamour per turn, up to Wyrd per victim.
Briarpatch: each movement requires reflexive Dexterity + Athletics or inflicts Immobilized; Durability equals Wyrd.
Field of Thorns: attack anyone breaking through once per turn with Wyrd dice and +0L; it may remain stationary.
loophole: Scatter a handful of Hedge thorns behind the changeling.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Gain the Glamour drained by Leechweed.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Briarpatch Athletics rolls suffer a penalty equal to Strength.

h-seemings.Beast: Field of Thorns has a +2L damage modifier.
h-seemings.Elemental: Apply Strength as a penalty to Dexterity + Athletics attempts to avoid the Briarpatch.
h-seemings.Fairest: Center the bramble radius on an ally and have it follow that character.
h-seemings.Wizened: Heal one bashing or lethal wound per Glamour stolen by Leechweed.

name: Trapdoor Spider's Trick
description: Step through an opening and visually disguise it as impassable or absent. Supernatural perception can pierce it through a Clash of Wills. Paying the higher cost extends the illusion until dawn or dusk.
duration: One scene or until the sun next crosses the horizon
loophole: Lure an enemy or rival through the opening first.

seemingBenefits.Ogre: Mark the illusion so allies automatically see through it.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: The illusion covers every sense and only supernatural perception can detect it.

h-seemings.Beast: Mark the illusion with danger, inflicting Shaken on investigators.
h-seemings.Darkling: Need not move through the passage to use the effect.
h-seemings.Elemental: Need not spend Willpower to extend duration.
h-seemings.Fairest: Impose -3 on attempts or Clashes to reveal the illusion.

name: Fortifying Presence
description: Spend a full scene offering meaningful support or perspective to a target who must still contest the invocation.
dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Wyrd vs. Resolve + Tolerance
success: Heal 2 mild Clarity damage or 1 severe Clarity damage; Clarity Conditions are unaffected.
exceptionalSuccess: Become a temporary Touchstone until after the target's next Clarity attack.
dramaticFailure: The changeling suffers a two-die Clarity attack.
loophole: Profess friendship to the target before multiple witnesses during invocation.

seemingBenefits.Fairest: Grant Defense equal to Presence against the target's next Clarity attack this story.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Instead attack the target's Clarity with Empathy dice, permanently forfeiting the ability to heal that target and possibly causing a breaking point.

h-seemings.Beast: Heal three mild Clarity damage instead of two.
h-seemings.Darkling: The subject ignores the next mild Clarity damage this chapter.
h-seemings.Elemental: Suppress one subject Clarity Condition for the chapter without resolving it.
h-seemings.Wizened: The subject's next failed breaking point is dramatic.

name: Hedgewall
description: Build a thorn castle up to Wyrd × 10 yards or meters across. Its walls grant substantial ranged concealment, have Durability 3 and Size 8, block passage, and deal 1 lethal per climbing turn without protection.
action: Extended; five successes, one turn per roll
success: The Hedgewall forms in the chosen layout.
exceptionalSuccess: Add one Thorns and Brambles manifestation for free.
failure: The Contract fails; in the Hedge, treat failure as dramatic.
dramaticFailure: The maze gives the changeling and allies Lost; in the Hedge it also alerts a hostile territorial hobgoblin.
loophole: Plant a Hedge seed or sapling immediately before invocation.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Enemies inside suffer −2 to Resolve rolls.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Duration lasts until the sun next passes the horizon.

h-seemings.Darkling: Minor harmless illusions impose Wyrd as a penalty to climbing and concentration actions.
h-seemings.Elemental: Spend 1 Willpower to invoke the exceptional-success effect.
h-seemings.Fairest: Intruders suffer -2 Composure while distracted by the castle's splendor.
h-seemings.Wizened: Create inanimate sentries and spend an instant action concentrating to see through one.

name: Pure Clarity
description: Choose one action this scene that would cause a breaking point and suffer none; it may be invoked retroactively in the same scene and only once per scene.
success: Ignore the chosen breaking point.
exceptionalSuccess: Gain armor 2 against the next Clarity attack, persisting until triggered.
dramaticFailure: Gain a Storyteller-chosen Clarity Condition that heals no Clarity when resolved.
loophole: Wear a real-metal gauntlet on one hand and a silk glove on the other.

seemingBenefits.Fairest: Also shield against actions inflicted upon the Fairest.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Invoke the Contract to protect a companion instead.

h-seemings.Beast: If you avoid a breaking point, allies present gain +3 on their next actions.
h-seemings.Darkling: Refund the Willpower if the effect is not needed during the scene.
h-seemings.Elemental: Force another changeling to suffer the breaking point you avoided, potentially causing one for you.
h-seemings.Wizened: Spend 1 additional Willpower to apply the effect to two breaking points.

name: Vow of No Compromise
description: Touch a target, make a spoken promise, and downgrade one aggravated damage to lethal; the changeling gains Stoic. Self-targeting is allowed.
loophole: Destroy a representation of the True Fae or kill one of their servants.

seemingBenefits.Ogre: Also gain Inspired regarding punishing whoever caused the mitigated damage.
seemingBenefits.Elemental: No touch is needed while the target is surrounded by or submerged in the associated element.

h-seemings.Beast: Give the subject two dots of Physical Skills until the next sunrise or sunset.
h-seemings.Darkling: Give a subject other than yourself Steadfast.
h-seemings.Fairest: Give +1 to a chosen Resistance Attribute until the next sunrise or sunset, recalculating derived traits.
h-seemings.Wizened: Give the subject +3 Defense against the character who harmed them until the next sunrise or sunset.

name: Whispers of Morning
description: Become weightless and intangible with everything carried: pass through physical barriers and neither touch nor be touched except magically. Interact with incorporeal fae and Hedge ghosts, but not ordinary Twilight beings.
loophole: Carry no weapons and wear no armor; acquiring either ends the Contract unless its cost is paid.

seemingBenefits.Ogre: Carry one person and extend the effect, contesting Presence + Occult + Wyrd against an unwilling target's Stamina + Wyrd.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Pick up Size 1 objects and choose whether they remain intangible when released.

h-seemings.Beast: Spend 1 Willpower to interact corporeally for the scene; attacks only deal bashing and successes are capped by lower of Wyrd or Strength.
h-seemings.Darkling: Reflexively attune to ghosts in Twilight and make a touched ghost tangible while contact persists.
h-seemings.Elemental: Choose freely whether to count as corporeal when interacting with the affinity element.
h-seemings.Fairest: Choose characters who can still perceive and hear you.

name: Boon of the Scuttling Spider
description: Move at normal Speed and act unhindered along walls, ceilings, slick surfaces, or any solid surface capable of supporting the changeling.
loophole: Swallow a live spider.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Use the restrain grapple move as though achieving exceptional success.
seemingBenefits.Darkling: Gain +2 to Stealth while traversing improbable surfaces.

h-seemings.Elemental: Squeeze through any gap large enough for your head at normal Speed.
h-seemings.Fairest: Move over surfaces unable to support your weight.
h-seemings.Ogre: Attack while moving at double Speed.
h-seemings.Wizened: Multiply crawling Speed by 1.5, rounded up.

name: Dreamsteps
description: Touch a nearby sleeper, synchronize breathing, and step from the mundane world into that dreamer's Bastion.
success: Enter the dreamer's Bastion through the Gate of Ivory rather than entering the changeling's own.
exceptionalSuccess: The Bastion suffers −1 Fortification until the dreamer wakes.
dramaticFailure: Enter the dream but suffer Flesh Too Solid, while the Bastion gains +1 Fortification until waking.
loophole: Hold the target's teddy bear or another childhood comfort object during invocation.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Assume the mien of a witnessed nightmare and once this chapter inflict Spooked when interacting with the dreamer awake.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: Gain Informed regarding the sleeper.

h-seemings.Darkling: Gain Inspired from the fascinating contents of the dreamer's mind.
h-seemings.Elemental: Appear as anyone the dreamer knows in waking life.
h-seemings.Ogre: Assume the mien of any positive dream witnessed and, once this chapter, grant the dreamer Steadfast.
h-seemings.Wizened: Create a simple prop from one desire, adding Wyrd dice to Persuasion with the dreamer.

name: Nevertread
description: Alter every footprint left after invocation to resemble another track, making mundane tracking impossible and supernatural tracking prompt a Clash of Wills. Tracks remain altered after the effect ends.
loophole: Leave a hidden or visible clue that reveals the changeling's identity if found.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Extend the effect to up to twice Stealth companions.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Leave traps with effective Safe Place dots equal to Dexterity.

h-seemings.Darkling: Gain +3 to related Clashes of Wills.
h-seemings.Elemental: Spend 1 additional Glamour to create a nearby false trail.
h-seemings.Fairest: Create a natural distraction pursuers must study for one minute or spend 1 Willpower to ignore.
h-seemings.Ogre: Instead create a marked safe trail granting allies +2 Defense while following it.

name: Pathfinder
description: Mix blood or spit with Hedge earth and draw a compass that reveals direction and distance to the nearest chosen general Hedge feature, such as a Market, Hollow, goblin fruit, or Gate of Horn. It reveals nothing about lurking creatures.
loophole: Take at least 1 damage from part of the Hedge during the scene.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Also learn the number and hostile intent of nearby creatures.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Know whether nearby goblin fruits are beneficial or harmful and identify their types.

h-seemings.Darkling: Know nearby Goblin Markets' general wares and whether their proprietors are broadly honest.
h-seemings.Elemental: Also pinpoint the closest example of the affinity element.
h-seemings.Fairest: When several routes fit, know which is best.
h-seemings.Ogre: Also know the safest route to the intended target.

name: Seven-League Leap
description: Make a jumping roll and clear a trajectory of 10 yards or meters per Wyrd dot.
loophole: Wear boots stolen from an enemy during the scene.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Gain +10 Speed for the scene and, when used in a foot chase, gain the Edge next turn.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Use the leap as an unarmed attack with +2 Strength and inflict Knocked Down on a hit.

h-seemings.Darkling: Use the leap to hide from an enemy without a roll when a concealed landing exists.
h-seemings.Elemental: Change trajectory once in midair.
h-seemings.Fairest: Travel 15 meters per Wyrd instead of 10.
h-seemings.Wizened: Add Wyrd to the next Physical action after landing.

name: Chrysalis
description: Choose two known Size 1–7 animal forms when learning the Contract and transform into either, copying Physical Attributes, Size, Speed, Health, mundane senses, movement, and communication with that species. Mythical forms grant anatomy but no supernatural powers.
loophole: Be in the chosen animal's natural habitat and close enough to touch one.

seemingBenefits.Ogre: Choose animals up to Size 15.

h-seemings.Darkling: May become smaller than Size 0 for 1 additional Glamour.
h-seemings.Elemental: Spend 1 Willpower to combine both forms, taking the higher traits and choosing Size.
h-seemings.Fairest: A mythical form gains one Storyteller-approved Dread Power.
h-seemings.Wizened: May become an animalistic machine with 1/1 armor and shift one dot between two Physical Attributes.

name: Flickering Hours
description: Choose each traveler affected when the Contract is invoked, including nearby hostile pursuers, and halve or double that target's passage of time through the Hedge. Until the sun next crosses the horizon, each quickened target also gains Fleet of Foot at effective dots equal to the changeling's Wyrd, maximum three, and always has the Edge in a chase. An unwilling target may pull free by winning Resolve + Wyrd contested by the changeling's Wits + Occult + Wyrd; this is resistance to the ongoing Effect, not an invocation roll.
duration: Until the changeling exits the Hedge
loophole: Smash an antique clock or other old timekeeping instrument while invoking the Contract.

seemingBenefits.Beast: After paying the Willpower cost to include others once, freely extend the Contract to anyone met during the journey.
seemingBenefits.Elemental: The path left behind becomes nearly impassable and applies the mechanical effects of Ice Tilt, described according to the Elemental's associated element.

h-seemings.Darkling: Once per day, pause time for Wyrd turns before the Contract's normal effect.
h-seemings.Fairest: Need not spend Willpower to extend the effect to motley or oath/bargain partners.
h-seemings.Ogre: An unwilling victim must deal Stamina lethal damage to the Ogre before attempting escape.
h-seemings.Wizened: Before expiry, reflexively spend 1 Glamour to reverse the time-rate alteration.

name: Leaping Toward Nightfall
description: Touch an object up to Size 5 or a character and send it forward through time, preserving location and momentum. Sentient targets may contest; the maximum displacement is one day per success and cannot be ended early.
dicePool: Intelligence + Occult + Wyrd vs. Resolve + Tolerance
action: Instant for objects or willing targets; Contested for unwilling targets
success: The target vanishes and reappears at the predetermined time, displaced beside any occupant of its original space.
exceptionalSuccess: Instead make the target arrive beside a character to whom the changeling owes a debt.
dramaticFailure: A random target is displaced and arrives with Volatile if an object or Spooked if a character.
loophole: Destroy a piece, Icon, or dream-object belonging to the target.

seemingBenefits.Beast: An arriving sentient target gains Disoriented, resolvable only with an ally or fading without a Beat at scene's end.
seemingBenefits.Darkling: Permanently erase the target's memory of the invocation scene, reversible supernaturally through a Clash of Wills.

h-seemings.Elemental: Spend 1 Willpower to send the target up to Wyrd x 2 kilometers away.
h-seemings.Fairest: Use the Contract on yourself.
h-seemings.Ogre: On arrival grant 2/2 armor or Durability 3 for one scene.
h-seemings.Wizened: Spend 1 Willpower to set a return time of up to Wyrd hours; returning inflicts Shaken.

name: Mirror Walk
description: Open a touched reflective surface into mirror space and exit through another previously touched mirror in the mundane world or Hedge. Bring hand-linked companions or reach through for an object; both surfaces must fit what passes.
success: Open the route and pass through to the selected mirror.
exceptionalSuccess: Both mirrors remain two-way portals for the scene, usable by anyone with permission.
dramaticFailure: Become Lost in mirror space, dropping any object being retrieved there.
loophole: Correctly name or describe someone currently reflected in the exit mirror.

seemingBenefits.Beast: End inside mirror space and gain +2 to navigate or deal with its denizens for the scene.
seemingBenefits.Elemental: After exiting, become visually mirror-like and invisible for invocation-successes minutes.

h-seemings.Darkling: On exceptional success, spend 1 Willpower to make the portal indefinite until it touches iron.
h-seemings.Fairest: On exceptional success, restrict who may enter or exclude a chosen category.
h-seemings.Ogre: On exceptional success, trap the open portal to deal Wyrd dice lethal to pursuers.
h-seemings.Wizened: Leave the portal open exceptionally, but after allies arrive its exit randomizes within Wyrd x 2 kilometers.

name: Talon and Wing
description: Spend ● per selected beast trait; effects stack.
options: Movement: gain a beast's transportation mode and +10 Speed.
Senses: gain +3 perception and ignore dim-light or darkness penalties.
Claws: unarmed attacks gain +0L, or aggravated damage if already lethal.
loophole: Eat fur, a talon, or another piece of the animal being emulated.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Become immune to mundane fatigue; supernatural fatigue prompts a Clash of Wills.
seemingBenefits.Darkling: For +●, add venomous fangs or claws: Wyrd Toxicity hourly outside action scenes, or grave Poisoned on a successful action-scene attack.

h-seemings.Elemental: Also choose the mind of a beast, gaining Advanced Action on Stealth and Survival.
h-seemings.Fairest: Also choose the grace of a beast, calculating Defense with higher of Dexterity or Wits.
h-seemings.Ogre: Claws gain +2 damage.
h-seemings.Wizened: Spend only 1 Glamour for two effects.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: Shape a nearby element into an archaic weapon with normal traits, spending successes to improve it.
options: +1 weapon modifier per success, maximum three.
Reduce Initiative penalty by one per success, maximum three.
Add 20/40/80 range per success, maximum three.
success: Create the weapon and divide successes among its enhancements.
exceptionalSuccess: Additional successes provide additional enhancements normally.
dramaticFailure: The element reacts wildly and inflicts an appropriate Tilt on the changeling.
loophole: Perform a showy, harmless trick with the mundane element as an instant action immediately before invocation.

seemingBenefits.Darkling: Create it from shadow and inflict Blinded instead of damage on a successful hit.
seemingBenefits.Elemental: With the affinity element, merge it into Mask and mien and once contest Presence + Intimidation against Stamina + Wyrd to inflict Stunned.

h-seemings.Beast: All-Out Attacks with the weapon grant +4 instead of +2.
h-seemings.Fairest: Spend 1 additional Glamour to gain two benefits per invocation success.
h-seemings.Ogre: Gain +3 Defense while wielding the weapon.
h-seemings.Wizened: Invoke using Crafts.

name: Might of the Terrible Brute
description: After winning a contested grapple roll, choose a grapple move that steals 1 Strength and adds it to the changeling, to a maximum +5. Strength 0 inflicts Immobilized; the bonus may exceed Wyrd limits.
loophole: Grapple multiple opponents at once.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Choose to steal Dexterity instead when invoking.
seemingBenefits.Elemental: Also gain the Giant Merit's effects.

h-seemings.Darkling: Inflict Shaken if the entire Attribute is stolen.
h-seemings.Fairest: Exceed the Wyrd-derived Attribute limit by one.
h-seemings.Ogre: Grapple-control actions exceptionally succeed on three successes.
h-seemings.Wizened: May steal Stamina instead, chosen at invocation.

name: Overpowering Dread
description: Methodically destroy an object while staring at a target to dominate them with fear.
dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Wyrd vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Inflict Frightened.
exceptionalSuccess: The next invocation against this target after the Contract ends costs no Glamour.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains Spooked.
loophole: Stand in shadows and surprise the target.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: Affect one additional target, contested separately.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: Instead make the target fear the surroundings, then comfort them to inflict Swooned regarding the Fairest.

h-seemings.Beast: Inflict Bestial instead of Frightened.
h-seemings.Darkling: Frightened lasts one additional scene.
h-seemings.Ogre: Gain 9-again on invocation.
h-seemings.Wizened: Place the fear's apparent source on another character present.

name: Primal Glory
description: Touch an element to gain immunity to mundane damage from it, half damage from magical sources, armor 1/1, and an aura dealing 1 lethal per turn to melee opponents.
loophole: Consume the element in some fashion.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: With the affinity element, damage everyone within Wyrd yards or meters instead.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Become fully immune to magical instances of the element.

h-seemings.Beast: The armor deals 2 lethal damage instead of 1.
h-seemings.Darkling: Gain 9-again on Dodge while armored.
h-seemings.Fairest: Gain +1 Presence for the duration.
h-seemings.Wizened: Gain one additional point of general or ballistic armor.

name: Touch of Wrath
description: Touch an object and wreck its material.
success: Deal 1 Structure damage per success.
exceptionalSuccess: The damage ignores Durability.
dramaticFailure: An unintended object gains Volatile.
loophole: During the scene, the owner stole or tried to steal from or cheat the changeling.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: Deal double damage to objects made entirely from natural materials.
seemingBenefits.Wizened: Use the Contract by sight without touching the object.

h-seemings.Beast: Deal double damage to entirely manufactured objects.
h-seemings.Darkling: Invoke with Larceny.
h-seemings.Fairest: Shape simple sculptures or reliefs from the object on success.
h-seemings.Ogre: Invoke with Brawl.

name: Elemental Fury
description: Create one chosen Environmental Tilt per Glamour spent in a 20-yard or meter radius, with the changeling immune. Spend additional Glamour to extend the radius by 20 yards or meters per point.
cost: ● per Tilt; +● per 20 yards or meters
loophole: Publicly proclaim rage, vengeance, or fury.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: Deal bashing damage equal to Presence to everyone caught when invoked.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: Exempt any visible targets from the Tilts.

h-seemings.Beast: Also inflict Disoriented on everyone in the area.
h-seemings.Darkling: Stealth exceptionally succeeds on three while active.
h-seemings.Ogre: Each extra Glamour extends range by 30 meters instead of 20.
h-seemings.Wizened: Add an EMP effect disabling digital technology for Wyrd turns.

name: Oathbreaker's Punishment
description: Sense the target's most serious unatoned broken promise and sculpt waking nightmares tied to it.
success: Create one waking nightmare per success to occur within a fortnight. Each lasts a scene and becomes a valid oneiromancy target with a Bastion and Dreaming Road.
exceptionalSuccess: Learn all unatoned broken vows and base nightmares on any combination.
dramaticFailure: The target learns the changeling's most significant broken oath or reneged deal.
loophole: The target made a still-active promise to the changeling during the scene.

seemingBenefits.Wizened: Learn every detail of the broken oath.
seemingBenefits.Elemental: Make the broken promise obvious to observers and inflict Notoriety.

h-seemings.Beast: Spend 1 Willpower to also inflict Wanton.
h-seemings.Darkling: The victim gains Frightened when the nightmare ends.
h-seemings.Fairest: Spend 1 Willpower to also inflict Obsession about making amends for the gravest offense.
h-seemings.Ogre: Each crafted nightmare may deal up to Wyrd dice bashing.

name: Red Revenge
description: Gain +3 Initiative, Intimidation, and all Physical Attributes, including derived traits; also gain armor 3/3 and Berserk.
loophole: Invoke it to avenge a loved one or friend.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: Gain +1 weapon modifier on Brawl and Weaponry attacks.
seemingBenefits.Ogre: Attacks also inflict Knocked Down.

h-seemings.Beast: Athletics and Brawl exceptionally succeed on three.
h-seemings.Darkling: Also gain +3 Defense.
h-seemings.Fairest: Also add +5 to one chosen Attribute.
h-seemings.Wizened: Grant the Contract's effect to another willing character.

name: Relentless Pursuit
description: Name or describe a target to know their direction, rough distance, and realm. Supernatural evasion prompts a Clash of Wills.
duration: Until the sun next crosses the horizon
loophole: Possess a bodily piece, Icon, or dream-object belonging to the target.

seemingBenefits.Beast: Also glimpse what the target is doing at invocation.
seemingBenefits.Elemental: At each horizon, spend ● to extend duration and gain a cumulative +1 chase modifier, maximum +5.

h-seemings.Darkling: Spend 1 Glamour to gain Trained Observer 1 for noticing the quarry; if already at 3, gain rote on Perception instead.
h-seemings.Fairest: Gain 9-again and remove the subject's 10-again in mundane contested pursuit actions.
h-seemings.Ogre: Give a tracked missing ally +2 to Resolve and Composure for the duration.
h-seemings.Wizened: Know the exact distance to the subject.

name: Thief of Reason
description: Erode the target's mental stability with a rising, horrible laugh. Successfully causing Clarity damage is a four-die breaking point.
success: Roll invocation successes as a Clarity attack; damage also removes 1 Willpower. Equivalent damage to non-changelings is temporary until scene's end.
exceptionalSuccess: Additional successes strengthen the Clarity attack normally.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains Dissociation.
loophole: Coax the target into doubting their own sanity during the scene, even jokingly.

seemingBenefits.Elemental: Add Wyrd to successful Clarity-attack successes when determining its damage pool.
seemingBenefits.Fairest: For +●, delay the effect until a chosen trigger within one day.

h-seemings.Beast: If the victim suffers Clarity damage, also inflict Cowed.
h-seemings.Darkling: Implant a false memory of what caused the breaking point.
h-seemings.Ogre: Limit the victim's Clarity damage, minimum 1, and suffer -1 on your own breaking point.
h-seemings.Wizened: Give the Clarity attack 8-again.

name: Cupid's Arrow
description: Touch a target's skin or hair to draw out and study their desires.
dicePool: Wits + Empathy + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Learn the target's most ardent desire and connected Conditions or Tilts, even if unconscious, and optionally redirect that passion and its effects to a new subject.
exceptionalSuccess: Also learn every obstacle between the target and the desire.
dramaticFailure: Mistakenly believe the target desires something chosen by the Storyteller or target's player.
loophole: Hold a living ivy flower.

name: Dreams of the Earth
description: Sing a lullaby to a visible target and place them in supernatural sleep.
dicePool: Presence + Expression + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: The target sleeps and only lethal damage can wake them; afterward they continue sleeping normally.
exceptionalSuccess: The supernatural sleep lasts the entire scene.
dramaticFailure: The changeling sleeps supernaturally for Mantle minutes.
loophole: Throw sand into the target's eyes; against an unwilling target this requires Dexterity + Athletics - Defense.

name: Gift of Warm Breath
description: Touch a willing target and remove all fatigue penalties, fatigue-related Tilts, temporary illnesses such as Sick or Poisoned, and all bashing damage.
loophole: Give the target food or drink made by the changeling.

name: Spring's Kiss
description: Call rain of any intensity within Mantle miles, normally allowing Heavy Rain; pay the higher cost to also inflict Flooded.
loophole: Wear bright yellow rain boots and cap.

name: Wyrd-Faced Stranger
description: Appear as the person a target most wants to see, including an imagined stranger. Against a group, use one target but the highest Composure opposes; everyone sees the same identity. Gain Mantle dice to Social rolls needed to maintain the portrayal.
dicePool: Presence + Subterfuge + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Assume the desired appearance.
exceptionalSuccess: The deception lasts until next dawn.
dramaticFailure: Unknowingly appear as the person the target least wants to see.
loophole: Carry something emotionally valuable to the target.

name: Blessing of Spring
description: Feed a day-brewed cordial to a plant, animal, or sapient creature. The target advances months, blooms or matures, heals all wounds and temporal disease or poison, and a changeling sheds one temporary Clarity Condition and heals 1 Clarity without a Beat. Changes revert after the scene and the target must consume three days' food.
dicePool: Intelligence + Medicine + Mantle vs. Stamina + Tolerance
action: Instant for plants and animals; Contested for sapient creatures
success: Apply the temporary growth and healing effects.
exceptionalSuccess: Advance a full year, regrow limbs, shed one Persistent Clarity Condition and heal 2 Clarity, accelerate willing pregnancies by 12 months, and make births during the scene permanent.
dramaticFailure: Creatures gain Fatigued and plants wither.
loophole: Decorate the target with ribbons and dance around them.

name: Gift of Warm Blood
description: Salve a target's wounds with an ointment of dreams and remembered spring flowers.
success: Per success, downgrade one wound from aggravated to lethal, lethal to bashing, or bashing to healed.
exceptionalSuccess: Also heal all remaining bashing damage.
dramaticFailure: Upgrade one bashing wound to lethal, or lethal to aggravated; spend +○ to prevent this if it would kill the patient.
loophole: Add the changeling's blood to the ointment, taking 1 lethal damage.

name: Pandora's Gift
description: After the target touches a tool, material, or the changeling, begin within one hour to Build Equipment expressing the target's desire. Halve construction time; the object lasts until the next horizon. Using it successfully as a bribe grants +3 Social dice and refunds 1 Glamour.
duration: Until the sun next crosses the horizon
loophole: Receive a valuable or sentimental gift from the target with no strings attached during the scene.

name: Prince of Ivy
description: Spit on the ground while naming enemies to create mobile grasping vines. Each turn make one new grapple within three yards or meters of a plant without spending the instant action; sacrifice the action for a second and Defense for a third. Plants roll 3 + invocation successes.
success: The plants grow and grapple chosen enemies.
exceptionalSuccess: At each new Initiative turn, deal 1 bashing to every grappled target.
dramaticFailure: Plants attack the changeling and allies for Mantle turns.
loophole: Stand barefoot in soil and cut the hand to sprinkle blood, taking 1 lethal damage.

name: Waking the Inner Fae
description: Give a target an invisible flower crown that drives pursuit of desire. The target gains Wanton; once per scene for the story, successfully tempting them restores 1 Willpower. Only one such target may provide Willpower at a time.
dicePool: Manipulation + Expression + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: The target accepts the crown and gains the stated effects.
exceptionalSuccess: Also inflict Persistent Obsession regarding the target's greatest current desire.
dramaticFailure: The changeling must wear the crown, gains Reckless, and cannot recover Willpower through Thread for the scene.
loophole: Tell the target one of the changeling's secret desires within the last scene.

name: Baleful Sense
description: Smell a target's deepest anger and redirect its subject.
dicePool: Wits + Intimidation + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Learn the target's greatest wrath and related Conditions or Tilts, even if denied, and optionally transfer all of them to a new subject.
exceptionalSuccess: Learn its origins and restraints and coax a nonsuicidal physical attack against its source without a roll.
dramaticFailure: The changeling suffers −2 on the next Mantle rolls.
loophole: Coax the target into screaming at the changeling during the scene.

name: Child of the Hearth
description: Inflict Extreme Heat or Extreme Cold on a large-room area while remaining immune, and remove the corresponding Personal Tilt from the changeling. This works without visible sunlight.
loophole: Blow on a fading ember or spark.

name: Helios' Light
description: Radiate true sunlight up to Mantle × 20 yards or meters. Direct observers suffer Blinded; sunlight-vulnerable creatures take half their normal damage.
loophole: Be unable to see in pitch darkness.

name: High Summer's Zeal
description: When a foe tries to flee an ongoing violent conflict, challenge them to continue.
dicePool: Presence + Persuasion + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: The target must spend ○ to flee; otherwise they must keep trying to win and cannot suffer Beaten Down.
exceptionalSuccess: The target also cannot retreat to range and must remain within five yards or meters.
dramaticFailure: The target heals Mantle damage and gains +1 Initiative.
loophole: The opponent drew first blood.

name: Vigilance of Ares
description: Automatically detect ambushes, hidden traps, and surprise attacks and add Mantle to Initiative.
loophole: Perform a martial exercise during the scene.

name: Fiery Tongue
description: Deliver a truthful claim of superiority as a physically devastating rebuke.
success: Deal successes in bashing damage, or lethal to fae, remove two Social maneuvering Doors, and make impression Hostile.
exceptionalSuccess: Deal lethal, or aggravated to fae.
dramaticFailure: Gain Mute until scene's end.
loophole: Verbally assert a genuinely superior status, possession, or skill over the target.

name: Flames of Summer
description: Gain +2 to all Physical rolls, ignore wound penalties, and remain conscious without a Stamina roll when the last Health box fills.
success: Gain the physical benefits.
exceptionalSuccess: Flames add +1L to unarmed attacks.
dramaticFailure: Strength falls to 1 for Mantle turns.
loophole: Violently crush and eat a chunk of ice immediately before invocation.

name: Helios' Judgment
description: Outdoors, pull down a returning thrown sunbeam with Damage (Mantle)L, ranges 10/30/50, Initiative −2, Strength 2, and Size 4. At the higher cost its damage becomes aggravated.
success: Create and wield the true-sunlight weapon.
exceptionalSuccess: Successful hits also inflict Knocked Down.
dramaticFailure: Drop the beam and cause Earthquake.
loophole: The target wears or touches pure gold.

name: Solstice Revelation
description: Flood a 30-yard or meter radius with revealing light. Mundane disguises test Manipulation + Wyrd penalized by Mantle or fail; new hiding is impossible, supernatural concealment prompts a Clash, and anyone may roll Wits + Composure to pierce the Mask.
loophole: Publicly reveal a deliberately kept secret.

name: Sunburnt Heart
description: Set a target's heart aflame with accumulated anger.
dicePool: Manipulation + Persuasion + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Inflict Berserk and gain Mantle dice to redirect the target's fury away from the changeling.
exceptionalSuccess: Affect a second target with a separate contest.
dramaticFailure: The target achieves exceptional success on three successes for the next action against the changeling.
loophole: Shine a bright light in the target's eyes unless they avoid it with reflexive Wits + Composure.

name: Autumn's Fury
description: Create a mobile thunderstorm within Mantle × 20 yards or meters, inflicting Heavy Rain and Heavy Wind while the changeling remains immune. At the higher cost, each turn reflexively attack everyone else in the area with Presence + Occult - Defense and 1L lightning.
loophole: Raise a metal rod, then lower it toward enemies as an instant action.

name: Last Harvest
description: Gain 9-again on the next Glamour harvest from a target, or 8-again if the emotion resonates with Autumn. Usable once per chapter.
loophole: Target the changeling's own Touchstone.

name: Tale of the Baba Yaga
description: Tell a familiar urban legend for several minutes and contest each listener individually.
dicePool: Manipulation + Subterfuge + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
action: Contested; takes at least a few minutes
success: Inflict Shaken on any or all listeners who lose the contest.
exceptionalSuccess: Affected listeners must also spend ○ to act against the changeling.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains Shaken.
loophole: Weave the Contract into an urban legend already familiar to every listener.

name: Twilight's Harbinger
description: Choose an ongoing event or circumstance. Thirteen minutes before it ends, or three action turns beforehand, an omen-bearing animal finds and warns the changeling.
duration: Until the lunar month ends or the event ends
loophole: Carry an object meaningfully connected to someone vital to the chosen event.

name: Witches' Intuition
description: Reveal one of the changeling's secret fears to sense and redirect a target's fear.
dicePool: Wits + Subterfuge + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Learn the target's greatest fear and connected Conditions or Tilts and optionally redirect them to another subject.
exceptionalSuccess: Also learn what caused, worsens, and eases the fear.
dramaticFailure: Reveal a fear the target did not already know.
loophole: Eat any part of the target, even a hair, nail, or drop of blood.

name: Famine's Bulwark
description: Read omens to question the current situation.
success: Ask one yes-or-no question per success; all answers but one are true, unless only one question is asked.
exceptionalSuccess: All answers are true and the changeling senses a path to the nearest non-fae supernatural phenomenon if pursued this scene.
dramaticFailure: Receive a false omen and temporary Obsession that resolves by endangering the changeling or allies while pursuing it.
loophole: Eat the most recent fruit of a plant personally raised.

name: Mien of the Baba Yaga
description: Approach unseen while ominous sounds announce the changeling, then appear as the target's greatest fear.
dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Inflict Frightened and require ○ for any rolled action; optionally let observers see the same fear. Changeling targets may suffer a Clarity attack.
exceptionalSuccess: Also inflict Immobilized for Mantle turns.
dramaticFailure: The changeling perceives the target as his own greatest fear and gains Spooked.
loophole: Whisper the specific name or title of the target's greatest fear.

name: Riding the Falling Leaves
description: Become a cohesive spray of autumn leaves, fly at Speed −3, squeeze through small gaps, and reflexively Dodge once per turn except against attacks that harm leaves. A successful Dodge may spend ● to inflict Spooked. Physical attacks and object manipulation are impossible.
success: Assume the leaf form.
exceptionalSuccess: Fly at full Speed and carry up to Mantle Size 1 objects.
dramaticFailure: Become half-transformed and Immobilized for Mantle turns.
loophole: Catch a naturally falling or windborne object at invocation.

name: Sorcerer's Rebuke
description: Touch an opponent and invoke Autumn to wither supernatural power.
success: Remove Glamour or another supernatural resource equal to successes.
exceptionalSuccess: Also inflict Cowed regarding the changeling.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains Spooked.
loophole: Earlier this scene, deliver a grand warning or threat lasting at least 30 seconds.

name: Tasting the Harvest
description: Consume each target's spoken fear, including the changeling's own.
success: Targets become immune to natural fear, add Mantle to contest supernatural fear, and gain +1 on actions against a fear designated by the changeling.
exceptionalSuccess: Contest supernatural fear with exceptional success on three successes and gain +1 weapon modifier on directed attacks.
dramaticFailure: Every target gains Shaken.
loophole: Legitimately frighten one target during the scene.

name: The Dragon Knows
description: Taste an object discarded by the target, or touch the target and taste the changeling's fingertips, to sense and manipulate the target's regrets.
dicePool: Wits + Empathy + Mantle vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Learn the target's deepest regret and any Conditions or Tilts connected to it, even if subconscious or forgotten. The changeling may redirect that regret and its attached Conditions or Tilts to a new subject.
exceptionalSuccess: Gain +2 to Social rolls made to shatter the target's hopes for the duration.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains Demoralized.
loophole: Look into the target's eyes for at least a few uninterrupted seconds.

name: Heart of Ice
description: Freeze the changeling's heart and skin. She becomes immune to mundane and supernatural cold, cold-only damage, all Environmental Tilts except heat-based ones, and attacks specifically targeting the heart. She cannot gain emotional Conditions while the Contract lasts.
loophole: Stand barefoot in something cold for (6 - Mantle) turns before invocation.

name: Ice Queen's Call
description: Spit on the floor to call winter Hedge ghosts and create a growing cold spot with the Blizzard Tilt out to Mantle × 20 yards or meters. The changeling is immune, and mournful whispers fill the area.
loophole: See or cause someone to shiver.

name: Slipknot Dreams
description: Speak with a target for a scene, consume his regrets, and encourage him to place his hopes in the changeling.
dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Mantle vs. Resolve + Tolerance
action: Contested; requires a scene of conversation
success: Soothe the target's regrets without erasing their source and inflict Swooned regarding the changeling.
exceptionalSuccess: The changeling may spend ○ to permanently suppress or alter the memory that caused the regret, unless reversed by supernatural means.
dramaticFailure: The target refuses to speak willingly to the changeling for one chapter.
loophole: The target accepted a valuable or sentimental gift from the changeling during the scene.

name: Touch of Winter
description: Touch a liquid surface to flash-freeze a five-yard or meter diameter around the changeling, expanding by another five yards or meters each turn while contact continues. The surface supports Mantle people and melts naturally when the Contract ends.
success: Freeze the liquid and continue expanding the frozen area while maintaining contact.
exceptionalSuccess: Either restore the liquid instantly at any time or impose the Ice Tilt at any time; the changeling is immune.
dramaticFailure: The changeling suffers Mantle bashing damage from frostbite.
loophole: Completely melt at least a handful of ice immediately before invocation.

name: Ermine's Winter Coat
description: Wear white and blend into the surroundings, gaining +3 Stealth and imposing -3 on attacks. Among several non-fae beings, halve Wyrd for bonuses used to track or identify the changeling and gain +3 to Clashes to appear mortal when strengthening the Mask. Dropping the Mask ends the Contract.
loophole: Create a small enclosed hiding place and conceal the changeling inside it during invocation.

name: Fallow Fields
description: Write and eat the name of someone the target loves to drain all positive emotion.
dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Mantle vs. Resolve + Tolerance
