success: The target cannot remember love, cannot regain Willpower through Virtue, Vice, or equivalent traits, and gains Broken.
exceptionalSuccess: At a spoken word during the same story, make the target relive the loss and regain Broken.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains Broken.
loophole: Write the name of one of the target's Touchstones.

name: Field of Regret
description: Summon ghosts of those who died lost in the Hedge on a winter night and direct them through visible targets.
success: Inflict lethal damage equal to invocation successes and remove 1 Willpower from each target.
exceptionalSuccess: Each target loses 2 Willpower instead.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains Disoriented.
loophole: Sing a melancholic song and allow a ghost to possess the changeling for at least 10 seconds.

name: Mantle of Frost
description: Radiate a mobile, flash-freezing Extreme Cold aura in a 20-yard or meter diameter. Others suffer a cumulative -1 to all rolls each turn, up to -5; thereafter they take 1 lethal per turn. Leaving removes the penalty, but reentry restores its current value. Damage exceeding Stamina inflicts Immobilized. The changeling is immune.
loophole: Dramatically remove a coat, let it fall like a mantle, and destroy it.

name: Winter's Curse
description: Touch a target to freeze their heart. Huntsmen bearing Fae Titles in place of hearts are immune.
dicePool: Presence + Survival + Mantle vs. Resolve + Tolerance
success: The target cannot cooperate in teamwork, spend Willpower, regain it through Thread, Virtue, or equivalent anchors, or suffer breaking points. They abandon allies and Aspirations; all Social impressions remain Average except the changeling's, and she adds Mantle to Social rolls against them. Deferred breaking points occur afterward.
exceptionalSuccess: Choose another present character: the target's impression of them becomes Hostile and that character suffers a Mantle penalty on Social rolls against the target.
dramaticFailure: The changeling freezes her own heart and gains Stoic.
loophole: Swallow an ice cube whole immediately before invocation.

name: Blessing of Forgetfulness
description: Brush the target's forehead to erase one continuous incident lasting no longer than a scene.
dicePool: Manipulation + Subterfuge + Wyrd vs. Composure + Tolerance
success: Permanently remove the incident and let the target's mind replace it with a plausible, harmless false memory. Conclusive evidence can later convince the target that the event occurred.
exceptionalSuccess: No mundane persuasion or evidence can convince the target that the event occurred.
dramaticFailure: The changeling forgets the previous five minutes.
loophole: The event hurt the target, but the changeling rendered aid or showed kindness.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.

name: Glib Tongue
description: Directly tell one lie to a mortal, who believes it unless demonstrably false. Against a supernatural target, add Wyrd as bonus dice to Subterfuge, to a maximum of +5.
loophole: Tell another target a lie that harms someone during the same scene.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.

name: Goblin's Eye
description: Kenning may trigger a separate Clash of Wills for each magically concealed phenomenon. For one supernatural subject revealed through kenning, ask one question per success about its true nature, weaknesses, activation, duration, closest Regalia, relative power, or directly associated promise, debt, or oath.
options: What is the true nature of this magic?
What is one weakness, bane, loophole, or catch this phenomenon possesses? This may be chosen repeatedly.
How do I activate this token or effect?
How long will this phenomenon last?
With which Regalia does this phenomenon most closely align?
What is the phenomenon's power level relative to my Wyrd?
Is a promise, debt, or oath directly associated with this phenomenon?
loophole: Burn an owl feather and mark the changeling's eyelids with its ashes.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.

name: Goblin's Luck
description: Make a random guess among a finite set of possibilities and receive a small lucky result, such as choosing the correct road or winning a minor scratch-ticket prize.
loophole: Freely extend the Contract's benefit to an unfriendly rival or enemy.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.

name: Huntsman's Clarion
description: Invoke the Contract in the Hedge to sense the presence, but not location, of any True Fae, Huntsman, other Arcadian denizen, or the changeling's own fetch within Wyrd miles. The changeling need not remain in the Hedge.
success: Sense whenever a listed Arcadian threat or the changeling's fetch is within range.
exceptionalSuccess: The Contract lasts until the sun next crosses the horizon.
dramaticFailure: The changeling gains Hunted, pursued by an agent of the Fae or perhaps her own Keeper.
loophole: Remain blindfolded for the duration.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.

name: Lost Visage
description: Immediately after a scene ends, erase the changeling from mortal memories of it: witnesses forget his appearance and badly misremember his name. Supernatural targets may resist with a Clash of Wills; True Fae and Huntsmen are immune.
loophole: Leave a distinctive personal possession at the scene.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.

name: Mantle Mask
description: Cosmetically dim the changeling's true Mantle and appear to possess another Court's Mantle up to the same rating, or no Mantle at all. This grants no mechanical benefits of the false Court.
loophole: Decorate the changeling's skin with symbols of the Court whose Mantle she imitates immediately before invocation.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.

name: Sight of Truth and Lies
description: Recognize any mundane lie spoken nearby, based on whether the speaker believes it, without learning the truth. Supernatural deception prompts a Clash of Wills. The changeling cannot lie; doing so ends the Contract.
loophole: Invoke the Contract at an official occasion, such as a Court hearing or mundane business meeting.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.

name: Uncanny
description: Grant the rote quality to the changeling's next mundane action that is neither resisted nor contested, including individual rolls within an extended action without reducing its required time.
duration: One instant action or one extended-action roll
loophole: The changeling has no dots in the Skill used for the task.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.

name: Wayward Guide
description: Alter signs along the changeling's path and inflict Lost on one mortal per Glamour spent. If the changeling targets herself, supernatural trackers must win a Clash of Wills or lose her trail for the scene.
loophole: The changeling also becomes confused and gains Confused.
goblinDebt: Gain 1 Goblin Debt on a successful invocation.
